title: GWAS participant-diversity monitoring: current-snapshot denominator audit
summary: A dynamic-monitor audit record for the ancestry composition of published GWAS participant denominators. It turns denominator diversity into a surface to be checked, while preserving dynamic-source and category limits.

status_history.note: Added as a denominator-diversity audit surface after rev0019 called for ancestry/diversity caveat records.

place.scope: GWAS Diversity Monitor snapshot; dynamic page; categories and data source require second-pass methods review

claims.claim: At retrieval, GWAS Diversity Monitor reports Version 1.0.0, last data check 2025-09-05 00:34:26, and a total-discovery-stage participant breakdown including 87.77% European, 5.33% Asian, 0.16% African, 3.71% African American or Afro-Caribbean, 1.71% Hispanic or Latin American, and 1.31% Other/Mixed.
what_would_change_status: A later monitor run changes the snapshot; this record should then be treated as historical snapshot rather than current state.

claims.claim: The page links its monitor to NHGRI-EBI Catalog, GitHub, a Nature Genetics citation, a maintainer, and a source-code Zenodo citation, making it a reusable audit surface rather than an isolated narrative claim.
what_would_change_status: Second-pass source review or newer primary evidence materially changes the claim scope.

claims.claim: The record treats monitor percentages as current-snapshot denominator evidence only; it does not use them as timeless prevalence estimates, does not adjudicate ancestry-category ontology, and requires methods/source-code review before quantitative synthesis.
what_would_change_status: Second-pass source review or newer primary evidence materially changes the claim scope.

evidence_refs.support_type: dynamic-source limitations encoded in this record

type_payload.denominator_surface: GWAS participant ancestry categories by discovery stage using monitor/data-source methods
type_payload.numerator_surface: published GWAS associations and their trait-specific discovery surfaces
bias_mechanisms_encoded: trait-specific invisibility if only global percentages are used
limits: Categories are not natural essences and require ontology review.
No causal claims about why representation patterns exist.

handling_notes: Do not treat ancestry categories as fixed natural kinds.
Report dynamic percentages with timestamp and category caveats.

unknowns: Methods/source-code review of the monitor not completed.
next_actions: Compare monitor values with GWAS Catalog article/static releases.

scope_qualifiers.phenotype_scope: GWAS participant diversity across monitor categories/traits
scope_qualifiers.ancestry_or_population_scope: dynamic category snapshot; source-code/methods review needed
scope_qualifiers.portability_caution: do not treat global percentages as trait-specific portability estimates
